provenance.construction: Split Pauli-labelled circulant-permutation stabilizer code over Z_71: 6 row blocks x 8 column blocks, generator (i, s) carries Pauli Lambda[i][j] in {X, Z} on qubit 71*j + (s + E[i][j]) mod 71. Each column block puts X on three row blocks and Z on the other three; the exponents solve pair-partition commutation equations (columns where two rows' labels differ are matched in pairs with equal exponent differences). Same label table as [[488,123,22]]; table in the research note. Found with the Hyra 2.0 research agent.
provenance.notes: Exact distance 22 by our own exhaustive Pauli-weight branch and bound (no logical of weight <= 21; see the research note); recorded as upper_bound because the board has no Pauli-weight certifier. Generators and witness are Y-free, so the symplectic double is a weight-8 CSS [[1136,286,22]]. No board entry has (n, k) = (568, 143), so this is not a block-Clifford relabeling of a board entry.
